title.en: Tensei Nanmin Shoujo wa Shimin-ken wo 0 Kara Mezashite Hatarakimasu

altTitles.en: The Reincarnated Refugee Girl Works Hard to Gain Citizenship from Zero

altTitles.id: Gadis Pengungsi Yang Bereinkarnasi Bekerja Keras Untuk Mendapatkan Kewarganegaraan Dari Nol

altTitles.ja: 転生難民少女は市民権を０から目指して働きます！

description.en:
Lill, who was reincarnated into a refugee settlement, is once again starving today.

To make matters worse, she's being shunned because of her lazy parents and is on the verge of being exiled!?

Determined to secure her place, she works hard every day to earn the trust of the residents, even if just a little. Her earnest efforts as a small girl gradually start to gain recognition from those around her.

Her dream? To one day eat a warm, hearty meal until she's full!

Then, she learns that even a refugee can live in town if they become a B-rank adventurer—so she sets her sights on escaping her refugee status!

Will this hardworking reincarnated girl win your heart too? A laid-back isekai adventure fantasy!
